drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Counsel, attached is Defendant’s draft response to the First Requests for Production. We will produce responsive, non-privileged documents and provide a privilege log for documents withheld on privilege grounds. Please let us know if you would like to discuss the scope or timing of production.

delivered.body: Defendant's Response to Requests for Production PRELIMINARY STATEMENT. Defendant responds to Plaintiff's First Requests for Production. 1. GENERAL OBJECTIONS. Defendant objects to each request to the extent it seeks privileged material. 2. PRODUCTION. Defendant will identify documents withheld on privilege grounds in a privilege log, with information sufficient to assess the claim without disclosing privileged content. 4. RESERVATION. Defendant reserves the right to supplement this response.
